chapters.title: The 1% Chance of Survival
chapters.goal: Survive the initial transition by exploiting a 100% crit-rate bug on a tutorial boss.
chapters.stakes_shift: From certain death to possessing an unintended mechanical advantage.

bridge.from_prev: Protagonist dies in the real world due to a freak statistical anomaly.
bridge.to_next: The protagonist enters the first hub city with a bag full of 'impossible' tutorial loot.

sections.title: The Final Calculation
sections.intent: Establish the protagonist's death and transition into the system.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist stands before the Tutorial Gate.

scenes.summary: Arthur dies in a hospital and wakes up in the System's white void.
scenes.outcome: Arthur accepts the terms of the isekai contract.
scenes.transition_in_text: The hospital heart monitor emitted a long, flat beep before the sterile room dissolved into a blinding white expanse.
scenes.transition_out_text: Arthur signed the digital contract, and the Clerk gestured toward a floating interface.

scenes.summary: Arthur navigates the character creation screen and spots a math error in the Agility stat.
scenes.outcome: Arthur discovers the Speed-to-Crit conversion exploit.
scenes.transition_in_text: The floating interface flickered to life, displaying a list of stats that didn't quite add up to Arthur's mathematical mind.
scenes.transition_out_text: Arthur allocated his points with a smirk, locking in the glitchy build.

scenes.summary: Arthur finishes his build and is transported to the entrance of the tutorial zone.
scenes.outcome: Arthur prepares to enter the tutorial with his exploited stats.
scenes.transition_in_text: A sudden rush of wind pulled Arthur through the void, depositing him on a stone path facing a massive iron gate.
scenes.transition_out_text: Arthur stepped toward the iron gate, feeling the weight of his new reality.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Protagonist stands before the Tutorial Gate.

sections.title: Debugging the Tutorial
sections.intent: Explore the mechanics of the 100% crit bug.
sections.end_condition: The tutorial boss spawns in the arena.

scenes.summary: Arthur enters the Tutorial Forest and encounters his first enemies, the Slimes.
scenes.outcome: Arthur confirms that every hit is a critical strike.
scenes.transition_in_text: The iron gate creaked open, revealing a lush forest where green slimes bounced with murderous intent.
scenes.transition_out_text: The last slime popped like a balloon, leaving behind a trail of critical hit notifications.

scenes.summary: Arthur experiments with movement speed to see how it affects his crit damage multiplier.
scenes.outcome: Arthur realizes the exploit scales infinitely with movement speed.
scenes.transition_in_text: Arthur began to sprint in circles, watching the numbers on his HUD climb higher with every step.
scenes.transition_out_text: Arthur stopped his sprint, his breath hitching as he saw the damage multiplier reach four digits.

scenes.summary: Arthur finds a hidden chest containing the 'Boots of the Swift' which further boosts his speed.
scenes.outcome: Arthur acquires gear that perfectly complements his exploit.
scenes.transition_in_text: Arthur pushed through a curtain of water, finding a small cave where a wooden chest sat waiting.
scenes.transition_out_text: Arthur laced up the glowing boots, feeling the air rush around his ankles.

scenes.summary: Arthur reaches the end of the forest and approaches the Boss Arena.
scenes.outcome: Arthur prepares for the final tutorial challenge.
scenes.transition_in_text: The forest thinned out, giving way to a massive stone structure that loomed over the landscape.
scenes.transition_out_text: The ground shook as the arena doors began to rise, revealing a dark interior.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The tutorial boss spawns in the arena.

sections.title: One-Shot Wonder
sections.intent: Conclude the tutorial by obliterating the boss.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist enters the portal to the hub city.

scenes.summary: The Tutorial Boss, a Giant Golem, spawns and Arthur begins his 'Hit & Run' strategy.
scenes.outcome: Arthur successfully dodges the Golem's first massive strike.
scenes.transition_in_text: Arthur stepped onto the sand, and the Giant Golem pulled itself from the arena floor with a roar of grinding stone.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Golem's fist smashed into the sand, but Arthur was already ten yards away.

scenes.summary: Arthur builds up maximum speed and delivers a single, glitch-powered strike to the Golem.
scenes.outcome: The Golem is instantly destroyed by a massive critical hit.
scenes.transition_in_text: Arthur accelerated to a blur, his sword glowing with the purple light of a guaranteed critical strike.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Golem exploded into a million digital shards, leaving only a shimmering blue portal in its wake.

scenes.summary: Arthur collects his legendary tutorial loot and steps into the portal.
scenes.outcome: Arthur leaves the tutorial and enters the hub city.
scenes.transition_in_text: The shimmering blue portal hummed with energy, beckoning Arthur to the world beyond the tutorial.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The protagonist enters the portal to the hub city.

chapters.title: Looting the Narrative
chapters.goal: Identify the 'Speed-to-Crit' conversion exploit while navigating the starter city's bureaucracy.
chapters.stakes_shift: From lucky survivor to deliberate exploiter of system physics.

bridge.from_prev: Arriving at the hub with high-tier loot and suspicious stats.
bridge.to_next: The protagonist joins a low-stakes dungeon crawl to test his 'Hit & Run' theory.

sections.title: The Iron Gate Bureaucracy
sections.intent: Introduce the hub city and the protagonist's initial struggle with registration.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist successfully registers at the Adventurer Guild.

scenes.summary: Arthur arrives in Iron Gate City and is overwhelmed by the scale of the hub.
scenes.outcome: Arthur finds his way to the Adventurer Guild.
scenes.transition_in_text: The portal spat Arthur out onto the sun-drenched cobblestones of a city that looked like a medieval fever dream.
scenes.transition_out_text: Arthur followed the signs toward the massive building with the crossed-swords banner.

scenes.summary: Arthur enters the Adventurer Guild and meets Guild Master Vance, who is suspicious of Arthur's level.
scenes.outcome: Arthur realizes he needs to hide his true stats.
scenes.transition_in_text: The Guild Lobby smelled of old parchment and expensive ale, dominated by a man with a chest like a beer keg.
scenes.transition_out_text: Vance narrowed his eyes at Arthur's registration form, his hand hovering over a detection crystal.

scenes.summary: Arthur uses a 'Lesser Illusion' scroll to mask his stats and completes his registration.
scenes.outcome: Arthur is officially registered as a Level 1 Adventurer.
scenes.transition_in_text: Arthur surreptitiously cracked the illusion scroll beneath the counter, a faint shimmer masking his true power.
scenes.transition_out_text: Vance grunted and stamped the paperwork, sliding a bronze guild tag across the wood.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The protagonist successfully registers at the Adventurer Guild.

sections.title: The Agility Loophole
sections.intent: Experiment with the Speed-to-Crit conversion in a controlled environment.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist achieves a stable 100% crit-rate via Agility stacking.

scenes.summary: Arthur finds a quiet training ground to test his build's limits without being watched.
scenes.outcome: Arthur finds a secure location for his experiments.
scenes.transition_in_text: Arthur ducked into the shadows of the lower district, finding a courtyard where the training dummies were more rot than straw.
scenes.transition_out_text: Arthur drew his sword, the blade catching a sliver of moonlight through the broken roof.

scenes.summary: Arthur equips several pieces of low-tier Agility gear he bought in the market.
scenes.outcome: Arthur observes the crit-rate rising with every point of Agility.
scenes.transition_in_text: Arthur began donning the mismatched leather pieces, his Agility stat ticking upward with each buckle fastened.
scenes.transition_out_text: Arthur swung at the dummy, the air whistling as his speed surpassed the system's intended limits.

scenes.summary: Arthur reaches the mathematical threshold where his crit-rate locks at 100%.
scenes.outcome: Arthur confirms the exploit is permanent as long as he maintains his Agility.
scenes.transition_in_text: A golden notification flashed in Arthur's vision: 'CRIT_CHANCE: OVERFLOW'.
scenes.transition_out_text: Arthur sheathed his sword, a dangerous confidence settling in his chest.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The protagonist achieves a stable 100% crit-rate via Agility stacking.

sections.title: Dressed for Success
sections.intent: Acquire the necessary gear to leverage the exploit in a real dungeon.
sections.end_condition: The protagonist steps into the entrance of the Sunken Crypt.

scenes.summary: Arthur visits a high-end blacksmith to commission specialized lightweight armor.
scenes.transition_in_text: The heat of the forge hit Arthur like a physical wall as he stepped into the district's most famous smithy.
scenes.transition_out_text: Arthur left the shop with a lighter purse and a vest that felt like a second skin.

scenes.summary: Arthur travels to the outskirts of the city to the entrance of the Sunken Crypt.
scenes.outcome: Arthur is ready to begin his first real dungeon run.
scenes.transition_in_text: The city walls receded as Arthur walked toward the graveyard where the Sunken Crypt's entrance lay hidden in the fog.
scenes.end_condition_echo: The protagonist steps into the entrance of the Sunken Crypt.
